## Detailed Service Offerings

### 1. Industrial Automation & PLC Control Panel Fabrication
- Custom PLC programming (Siemens S7-1200/1500, Allen Bradley ControlLogix/MicroLogix, Schneider Electric, Delta, Mitsubishi).
- Custom control panel engineering, assembly, wiring, and testing complying with industrial safety standards.
- Servo motor drive programming and multi-axis motion control.
- Machine vision system integration for automated inspection and sorting.

### 2. Process Control & Instrumentation
- Distributed Control System (DCS) architecture design and deployment.
- High-precision Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) loop tuning for temperature, pressure, flow, and level management.
- Calibration and maintenance for electromagnetic flowmeters, ultrasonic sensors, and pressure transmitters.

### 3. SCADA Systems & Enterprise Software Solutions
- Custom human-machine interface (HMI) screen design and SCADA software development.
- Real-time data logging, trend visualizers, fault alarming, and historical reporting.
- Cloud-based enterprise dashboards (Featured Solution: NetZero Carbon & Energy Monitoring System with live demo at https://tapgreen.vercel.app).
- API integrations connecting shop-floor PLCs to enterprise database systems.

### 4. Custom PCB Design & Valve Control Electronics
- Dedicated PCB circuit board design for automated valve actuation.
- Custom electronic modules for multi-valve control, motor driver boards, and industrial communication interfaces.

### 5. Industrial IoT & Industry 4.0 Smart Factory Solutions
- Industrial IoT edge gateways with RS485 Modbus RTU/TCP, MQTT, and OPC-UA connectivity.
- Remote telemetry systems for real-time monitoring of power, production throughput, and machine health.
- Predictive maintenance algorithms and automated alert triggers via SMS, WhatsApp, and Email.

### 6. Special Purpose Machinery (SPM) & Custom Machine Manufacturing
- Complete design, machining, assembly, and electrical control wiring for bespoke manufacturing machinery.
- End-of-Arm Tooling (EOAT) for robotic arms and automatic pick-and-place systems.
- Legacy machine retrofitting: upgrading mechanical setups with modern controllers, VFDs, and digital sensors.

---

## Product Categories & Specifications

### 1. Industrial Sensors
- **Proximity Sensors**: Inductive and capacitive sensors for non-contact object detection.
- **Photoelectric Sensors**: Diffuse-reflective, retro-reflective, and through-beam sensors.
- **Temperature & Pressure Sensors**: RTD Pt100, thermocouples, pressure transducers (4-20mA / 0-10V output).
- **Ultrasonic & Level Sensors**: Non-contact continuous liquid and solid level measurement.

### 2. Process & Control Valves
- **Solenoid Valves**: Direct-acting and pilot-operated valves for air, water, steam, and neutral fluids.
- **Motorized & Pneumatic Control Valves**: Motor-driven ball valves, butterfly valves, and proportional control valves.
- **Custom PCB-Controlled Valve Assemblies**: Engineered multi-port valve setups with built-in electronic timing and safety overrides.

### 3. Automation Hardware & PLCs
- **Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)**: Modular and compact PLCs with expandability for digital/analog I/O.
- **Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs)**: Touchscreen operator panels with IP65 front protection.
- **Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)**: Energy-efficient speed control for industrial motors.

### 4. Flow & Analytical Instruments
- **Electromagnetic Flow Meters**: Precision volumetric flow measurement for conductive liquids.
- **Ultrasonic Flow Meters**: Clamp-on and inline flow instruments for clean liquids.
- **Analytical Sensors**: pH, conductivity, and dissolved oxygen sensors for water treatment and chemical processing.
